patch.description: Updates a delivery manifest. Only provided key-value pairs provided are updated.

parameters.name: manifestNumber
parameters.description: Manifest number of the manifest to be updated

trailerNumber.description: The trailer number for the manifest.

vehicleNumber.description: The vehicle number for the manifest

get.description: Retrieve return events from the Maven system

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: ISO8601 datetime of the first data being polled (inclusive).

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: ISO8601 datetime of uploaded timestamp of the last data (inclusive).

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Array of Ids of events to be returned.

get.description: Provide summarized ELD information for all active drivers in a given fleet

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination value taken from pagination.nextCursor in the result.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: If not specified, by default API returns data for 8 days window

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: If not specified, by default API returns data for 8 days window

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: By default API returns 1000 rows.  Max 2000.

get.description: The vehicle locations API returns a history of all recorded telematics pings for any vehicle that is installed with a Maven Vehicle Data Adapter (VDA).

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: ISO8601 string of the first data being polled (inclusive)

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: ISO8601 string of the last data being polled (inclusive)

parameters.name: groupCode
parameters.description: If provided the response will include only locations for vehicles that belong to that group

parameters.name: extendedParams
parameters.description: If true, the response will include additional attributes: rpm, heading, city, state, postalCode, speed, fuelLevel

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API Key required to authenticate request

get.description: The vehicle locations snapshot API returns a list of the latest ping/location for all vehicles in your fleet that are installed with a Maven Vehicle Data Adapter (VDA).

parameters.name: groupCode
parameters.description: If provided the response will include only locations for vehicles that belong to that group

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset to indicate from which vehicle the locations should be read next time

parameters.name: extendedParams
